name_normalization: NFKD -> ASCII ignoring diacritics -> lowercase -> retain a-z and 0-9; explicit audited aliases only; no fuzzy matching
by_team_semantics: season|team_abbreviation -> qualifying seasonal-roster record IDs; excludes transaction-only associations
by_jersey_semantics: season|team_abbreviation|single jersey text -> all known roster player IDs, not a unique identity; raw multi-number text preserved in stint
not_in_rating_scope_semantics: No player-season record was selected; inspect history if available. This is different from availability.status=missing_record in an existing record.
